institution: Politechnika Gdańska / Gdańsk University of Technology, Faculty of Electronics, Telecommunications and Informatics
program: Sound and Vision Engineering (Inżynieria dźwięku i obrazu) — specialisation of MSc Electronics and Telecommunications
qualification: Magister inżynier (MSc) — but the English-taught MSc does NOT carry this specialisation
accreditationStatus: CAUTION. The Multimedia Systems Department runs a research & education specialisation called Sound and Vision Engineering, taught at Gdańsk Tech for over 25 years. HOWEVER the English-taught 'Master of Science in Electronics and Telecommunications' page lists only two specialisations: 'Radio Communication Systems and Networks' and 'Computer Electronic Systems'. Sound and Vision Engineering is NOT offered in the English-taught MSc — it exists only within Polish-taught programmes.
language: Polish for the Sound & Vision specialisation; English only for the two other specialisations
durationEcts: English MSc: 2 years / 4 semesters / 120 ECTS, or 1.5 years / 3 semesters / 90 ECTS
whatYouStudy: Acoustics, audio signal processing, multimedia systems, psychoacoustics, sound and image engineering — an ENGINEERING degree, not record-production/studio craft
entryRequirements: VERBATIM (English MSc): 'For 3-semester program: Electronics and Telecommunications, Informatics and obtaining a minimum of 210 ECTS points at BSc studies'; 'For 4-semester program: Electronics and Telecommunications, Automatics and Robotics, Informatics, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Technical Physics, Mechatronics, other related fields (strong background in mathematics and physics)'
acceptsNonMusic: YES — explicitly an engineering entry route. A BSc Software Engineering fits 'Informatics'. No music background required or wanted.
auditionSpec: NONE. No audition, no ear-training exam, no production test. Admission is on academic transcript.
tuitionNonEU: 10,000 PLN per semester for non-EU citizens on the English-taught MSc E&T (≈ €2,340/semester, ≈ €4,680/year at 4.27 PLN/EUR). Range across Gdańsk Tech master's programmes is 9,000–10,750 PLN/semester. EU citizens pay nothing.
otherFees: UNVERIFIED (application fee not stated on the tuition page)
totalCostEstimate: ≈ €9,400 tuition for a 2-year English MSc plus living costs; but the Sound & Vision specialisation is not available in English
scholarshipName: NAWA Banach Scholarship Programme (Poland) — UNVERIFIED whether Tunisia is currently eligible; NAWA Łukasiewicz programme is closed (last call 2020)
languageRequirement: English for the English-taught MSc; Polish for Sound & Vision Engineering
englishTest: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL or equivalent typically required — UNVERIFIED exact threshold on the official page
deadline: UNVERIFIED — 'Dates and deadlines' section not retrieved
verdict: EXCLUDE for this candidate's goal — the audio specialisation is Polish-only, and even in Polish it is an electronics degree, not record-making. Listed here because it was on the search brief and the negative finding matters.

institution: Akademia Muzyczna im. Feliksa Nowowiejskiego w Bydgoszczy (Feliks Nowowiejski Academy of Music)
program: Reżyseria dźwięku (Sound Engineering / Sound Direction), Wydział I — Kompozycji, Teorii Muzyki i Reżyserii Dźwięku
qualification: Magister sztuki (Master of Arts) — studia II stopnia
accreditationStatus: REAL SECOND CYCLE. One of only two Polish institutions with a master's-level reżyseria dźwięku (the other is Chopin University Warsaw, already covered). Confirmed in the national programme index: 'I stopnia (licencjat)' and 'II stopnia (magister)' – 3 years and 2 years respectively.
language: Polish only. No English-taught track found.
durationEcts: 2 years / 4 semesters (120 ECTS — UNVERIFIED exact ECTS)
whatYouStudy: Sound direction: recording, editing and sound production; acoustics; shaping of acoustic space; analysis of phonic signals; analogue and digital sound processing; music history. Faculty is shared with composition and music theory.
entryRequirements: VERBATIM (from the published recruitment rules, second cycle): 'Studia stacjonarne drugiego stopnia — 2-letnie: wymagane przedstawienie dyplomu potwierdzającego ukończenie studiów', maximum 150 points across stages I and II of the exam. Exact wording of the required prior field of study UNVERIFIED — the amuz.bydgoszcz.pl server returned HTTP 503 repeatedly and the 2026/27 rules PDF could not be retrieved.
acceptsNonMusic: UNVERIFIED — could not be confirmed from an official page. The FIRST-cycle exam explicitly includes 'Egzamin kierunkowy z zakresu przedmiotów: kształcenie słuchu i harmonia funkcyjna' (ear training and functional harmony) plus a ~10-minute performance on the candidate's own instrument, which strongly implies conservatoire-level musicianship is assumed at entry to the school. A software-engineering BSc holder with no music training would face a hard gate.
portfolioSpec: UNVERIFIED — no portfolio specification published on any page retrievable at time of search.
auditionSpec: EAR-TRAINING / APTITUDE EXAM (candidate cannot pass). Second-cycle exam described as: 'kolokwium z zakresu kierunku studiów sprawdzające predyspozycje kandydata do zawodu reżysera dźwięku: sprawdzenie wrażliwości i wyobraźni dźwiękowej, wrażliwości na barwę dźwięku, pamięci muzycznej i dźwiękowej oraz ogólnej orientacji w dziełach muzycznych, filmowych, teatralnych, telewizyjnych i radiowych oraz nagraniach muzycznych – egzamin ustny'. This is an aural-aptitude and musical-memory test, NOT a practical production test and NOT a portfolio review. The first cycle additionally requires ear training, functional harmony and a live instrument performance.
tuitionNonEU: UNVERIFIED. The academy's own English page states only that 'the height of fees for studies in Polish and English languages will be provided shortly'. No published non-EU rate could be confirmed; the site returned HTTP 503 on repeated attempts. Do NOT assume Polish public-university study is free — non-EU nationals without a Karta Polaka or permanent residence normally pay a university-set fee.
scholarshipName: NAWA (Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange) — Banach Scholarship Programme. NOTE: the NAWA Łukasiewicz programme is CLOSED (last call 2020). Banach eligibility for Tunisia UNVERIFIED.
languageRequirement: Polish — level UNVERIFIED (typically B2 + certificate for degree study in Polish)
deadline: PRIOR CYCLE. Registration for the 2026/27 intake closed 17.06.2026 (first cycle, IRK system); second-cycle exams have historically run late June (e.g. 27–30 June 2023). Expect an equivalent mid-June 2027 deadline for a September 2027 start — UNVERIFIED for 2027/28.
verdict: GENUINE MASTER'S but WRONG GATE — Polish-only teaching plus an aural-aptitude oral exam. Not viable for this candidate.

institution: Akademia Muzyczna im. Karola Szymanowskiego w Katowicach (Karol Szymanowski Academy of Music)
program: Jazz i muzyka estradowa (Jazz and Popular Music), specjalność: REALIZACJA DŹWIĘKU (Sound Production) — Wydział Kompozycji, Interpretacji, Edukacji i Jazzu
qualification: Magister sztuki (Master of Arts) — studia stacjonarne DRUGIEGO STOPNIA (full-time second cycle), 2 years
accreditationStatus: REAL, FULL-TIME SECOND CYCLE, CONFIRMED FOR 2026/2027 from the Academy's own Informator table: 'Jazz i muzyka estradowa … Realizacja dźwięku — pierwszego stopnia / drugiego stopnia'. NOTE A CHANGE OF OFFER: in the 2023/24 rules the sound track at second cycle was 'Realizacja nagłośnienia' and was NIESTACJONARNE (part-time); for 2026/2027 the Academy publishes ONLY full-time first- and second-cycle studies, and the second-cycle sound specialisation is 'Realizacja dźwięku'. Rector may cancel a specialisation if too few candidates apply.
language: Polish only. Tuition schedule explicitly headed 'CUDZOZIEMCY – OPŁATY ZA STUDIA STACJONARNE W JĘZYKU POLSKIM' (foreigners — fees for full-time studies in the Polish language). No English-taught track.
durationEcts: 2 years / 4 semesters (120 ECTS — ECTS figure UNVERIFIED)
whatYouStudy: Sound production inside the Jazz and Popular Music faculty — mixing, studio and concert recording, audiovisual sound, game audio and radio forms are all named in the exam brief as legitimate work categories, which indicates a record/production-facing curriculum rather than a live-PA or electronics one.
entryRequirements: VERBATIM (2026/2027 second-cycle Realizacja dźwięku admission sheet): '• oryginał lub odpis dyplomu ukończenia studiów pierwszego stopnia wraz z suplementem lub studiów drugiego stopnia wraz z suplementem lub jednolitych studiów magisterskich; • w przypadku uzyskania dyplomu ukończenia studiów poza granicami Polski uprawniającego do kontynuacji studiów w Polsce, kandydat przedkłada stosowny dokument przetłumaczony na język polski przez tłumacza przysięgłego.' Foreigners additionally submit the documents named in §3 of the annex to the Senate resolution of 24 June 2025.
acceptsNonMusic: YES — EFFECTIVELY OPEN. QUOTED: the only academic entry document required is 'dyplom ukończenia studiów pierwszego stopnia wraz z suplementem' — ANY first-cycle degree, with NO named field of study, NO requirement of a music-school diploma, and NO ear-training or instrument component anywhere in the second-cycle exam sheet. (By contrast the FIRST-cycle Realizacja dźwięku exam does require 'Solfeż barwy: test wrażliwości słuchowej' and 'Kształcenie słuchu (egzamin ustny): ćwiczenia melodyczno-rytmiczne' — the master's entry drops both.) A BSc in Software Engineering satisfies the stated requirement on its face.
portfolioSpec: EXACT, VERBATIM: 'Zaprezentowanie komisji trzech zróżnicowanych prac realizacyjnych (miks, nagranie koncertu, materiał audiowizualny, dźwięk do gier, forma radiowa itp.) w postaci plików umożliwiających odtworzenie na komputerze z dowolnego nośnika danych ze złączem USB.' — THREE varied production works (a mix, a concert recording, audiovisual material, game audio, a radio form etc.), supplied as files playable on a computer from any USB storage device. No track length, bitrate or file format is prescribed.
auditionSpec: NO AUDITION AND NO EAR-TRAINING EXAM. VERBATIM: 'Egzamin wstępny obejmuje egzamin praktyczny, rozmowę kwalifikacyjną. Egzamin oceniający uzdolnienia, w tym rozmowa kwalifikacyjna.' The 'egzamin praktyczny' at second cycle consists of presenting the three portfolio works to the panel plus an interview — i.e. a PORTFOLIO REVIEW + INTERVIEW gate. Pass mark: 'Maksymalna ocena … wynosi 100 pkt. Egzamin wstępny uważa się za zdany, jeśli kandydat uzyska co najmniej 60 pkt.'
tuitionNonEU: 21,000 PLN PER SEMESTER = 42,000 PLN per year ≈ €9,850/year (at 4.27 PLN/EUR). VERBATIM from Zarządzenie Rektora nr 5/1/2026 of 19 January 2026: 'CUDZOZIEMCY – OPŁATY ZA STUDIA STACJONARNE W JĘZYKU POLSKIM (OPŁATA ZA SEMESTR) … Studia pierwszego i drugiego stopnia 21 000,00 zł'. Exempt only for persons listed in art. 324(2) of the 2018 Higher Education Act or studying under separate agreements. This is the clearest proof in this sweep that CEE is NOT automatically cheap for a non-EU national.
otherFees: Recruitment fee 150.00 PLN ('WYSOKOŚĆ OPŁATY ZA PRZEPROWADZENIE REKRUTACJI w związku z koniecznością sprawdzenia uzdolnień artystycznych wynosi 150,00 zł'). Student residence 'PARNAS': 590.00 PLN/month per person in a two-bed room without bathroom, 650.00 PLN/month with bathroom. Student card 22 PLN; document authentication for foreign legal use 26 PLN. Payment dates: 30 October (winter semester), 15 February (summer semester).
totalCostEstimate: ≈ €19,700 tuition over two years, plus ≈ €140/month hall of residence (≈ €3,400 over two years) plus living → ≈ €28,000–32,000 total. Unless a fee waiver or scholarship is secured, this is the most expensive genuinely suitable option found in the region.
scholarshipName: The Academy publishes 'Kandydaci na studia – CUDZOZIEMCY – zasady dotyczące ubiegania się o stypendium' (rules for foreign candidates applying for a scholarship) and links 'Stypendia Pomostowe' on its Cudzoziemcy/Foreigners page — CONTENTS AND AMOUNTS UNVERIFIED. Nationally: NAWA Banach Scholarship Programme (the NAWA Łukasiewicz programme is CLOSED, last call 2020); Tunisia's eligibility for Banach is UNVERIFIED.
scholarships: Institutional scholarship rules for foreigners exist and are published, but amounts and eligibility could not be read. WORTH A DIRECT ENQUIRY — the fee is the only real obstacle here.
languageRequirement: Polish. Level not stated on the admission sheet — UNVERIFIED. Foreign diplomas must be translated by a sworn translator (tłumacz przysięgły).
deadline: PRIOR CYCLE (2026/2027): online registration in the IRK system and submission of signed documents 13 April – 22 May 2026. Entrance exams at the Academy 17–18 June 2026. Conditional pass list by 15 July 2026; final admitted list by 28 September 2026. 2026 first-cycle graduates may supply a completion certificate up to 25 September 2026. EXPECT AN EQUIVALENT MID-APRIL TO LATE-MAY 2027 WINDOW for a September 2027 start.
sourceUrl: https://am.katowice.pl/rekrutacja/informacje/informator-484 ; https://am.katowice.pl/assets/media/3afb3b289cac68ba1568cdbe2e5bb76a.pdf (second-cycle Realizacja dźwięku admission sheet) ; https://am.katowice.pl/assets/media/2db3f3d4df9201e31701b6b03e3551aa.pdf (Zarządzenie Rektora 5/1/2026, fees) ; https://am.katowice.pl/rekrutacja/informacje/cudzoziemcy-foreigners-486
verdict: STRONGEST GATE IN THE WHOLE SWEEP. A full-time, accredited 2-year MA in sound production whose only entry requirements are ANY bachelor's degree plus THREE varied production works on a USB stick, judged by portfolio review and interview — no audition, no ear test, no music degree. The two blockers are Polish-language teaching and 42,000 PLN/yr (≈€9,850) non-EU tuition.

institution: Vysoká škola múzických umení v Bratislave (VŠMU / Academy of Performing Arts), Filmová a televízna fakulta (Film and Television Faculty)
program: Zvuková skladba (Sound Composition) — magisterský študijný plán within the study programme 'Strihová a zvuková skladba' (Editing and Sound Composition)
qualification: Mgr. art. (Master of Arts) — second cycle

entryRequirements: Application by 8 April 2026 via E-PRIHLÁŠKA. Entrance interview must be taken IN PERSON on the set date — 'Všetci uchádzači o štúdium na magisterskom stupni FTF VŠMU môžu absolvovať prijímací pohovor iba prezenčne a v školou stanovenom termíne.' acceptsNonMusic: UNVERIFIED — could not be confirmed. Entry to a Mgr. art. in the Slovak system normally requires a completed first cycle in the same or a closely related field of art.
portfolioSpec: UNVERIFIED — number of works, length and format not published outside the prospectus PDF.
auditionSpec: UNVERIFIED. Known: a compulsory in-person entrance interview (prijímací pohovor) on a fixed date. Whether it includes an ear test, a portfolio review or a practical production task could not be determined.

totalCostEstimate: UNVERIFIED for the Slovak-taught route; ≈€9,000 over two years if a foreign-language rate applied

This is the closest thing in the region to genuine record-making taught at master's level.
entryRequirements: VERBATIM (translated from the FDU master's admission rules): applicants must have completed basic academic studies with a minimum of 240 ECTS credits, or the equivalent under prior regulations.
acceptsNonMusic: UNVERIFIED — the rules do not restrict the prior field by name, but the qualification exam contains an ELIMINATORY musical-ability component, which functions as a de-facto music gate. COULD NOT QUOTE ANY PAGE SAYING NON-MUSIC BACKGROUNDS ARE ACCEPTED.
portfolioSpec: A 'representative work' (reprezentativni rad) must be submitted and defended — worth up to 10 of 70 qualification-exam points. NUMBER OF TRACKS, LENGTH AND FORMAT ARE NOT SPECIFIED on the published admission page. UNVERIFIED.
auditionSpec: MIXED GATE — three components: (1) EAR/APTITUDE TEST, ELIMINATORY: assessment of musical ability and knowledge of acoustics and audio technology, minimum 3 points required to proceed, max 5 points. He cannot be confident of passing this. (2) PORTFOLIO: defence of the submitted representative work, max 10 points. (3) PRACTICAL PRODUCTION TEST — FAVOURABLE: execution and defence of a practical work during the exam itself, max 15 points. Plus an interview on creative potential, max 40 points (the largest single block). Prior academic GPA contributes up to 30 points (GPA × 3). Budget-funded threshold 80 points; self-funded threshold 60 points.
tuitionNonEU: 660,000 RSD per year for 'other foreign citizens' (2026/27 published rate) ≈ €5,640/year at ~117 RSD/EUR. Serbian citizens pay 440,000 RSD; citizens of neighbouring countries 550,000 RSD. The non-EU rate is 50% above the domestic rate — do not assume the Serbian rate applies.
otherFees: UNVERIFIED (application/exam fee not published on the retrieved page)
totalCostEstimate: ≈ €5,640 tuition for the one-year master's, plus ≈ €500–700/month living in Belgrade → ≈ €12,000–14,000 total
scholarshipName: Serbian Government / World in Serbia bilateral scholarship scheme (Ministry of Education, via diplomatic channels) — amount and Tunisia eligibility UNVERIFIED. Serbia's bilateral scheme is generally aimed at Non-Aligned Movement partner states, which historically includes Tunisia.
scholarships: UNVERIFIED. Note the internal 'budget-funded' (budžet) places at 80+ points — these waive tuition but are normally reserved for Serbian citizens.
deadline: PRIOR CYCLE — registration 7–8 October 2026, 09:00–14:00 at the Faculty Secretariat; entrance exam 12–13 October 2026, 09:00, room KS1. Serbia's academic year starts in October, so a 'September 2027 intake' would in practice be an OCTOBER 2027 start with a late-September/early-October 2027 application.
verdict: BEST CONTENT MATCH IN THE REGION for record-making (classical and popular music recording taught as core subjects) and it contains a genuine PRACTICAL PRODUCTION TEST. Blockers: Serbian-language teaching, an eliminatory musical-ability/acoustics test, and €5,640/yr non-EU tuition with no confirmed scholarship.

institution: Sveučilište u Zagrebu, Akademija dramske umjetnosti (ADU / Academy of Dramatic Art)
program: Diplomski sveučilišni studij Montaža — smjer/modul Oblikovanje zvuka (Graduate university study in Editing — Sound Design specialisation)
qualification: Magistar/magistra montaže — oblikovanje zvuka (Master), second cycle
accreditationStatus: REAL SECOND CYCLE. The graduate programme lasts two years (four semesters), 120 ECTS, with two specialisations: Editing and Sound Design. ADU describes Sound Design as a module of the Editing programme but 'largely designed as an independent programme'.
whatYouStudy: VERBATIM (translated): to educate creative and professional practitioners who through artistic, theoretical and professional courses acquire knowledge and skills in the field of SOUND FOR FILM, TELEVISION AND OTHER PERFORMING, BROADCASTING AND STAGE ARTS. This is film/TV sound design, NOT music record production.
entryRequirements: General and specific entrance-exam conditions (application deadlines, submitted works, exam procedure, scoring, threshold, consultations, right to direct admission) are announced ANNUALLY on ADU's website and on ADU premises — i.e. not fixed in the programme description. UNVERIFIED for 2027.
acceptsNonMusic: UNVERIFIED — no statement found. The portfolio requirement (an audiovisual work whose sound design the applicant created) is the effective gate, which is field-specific rather than music-specific.
portfolioSpec: SPECIFIED, VERBATIM (translated): applicants for the Sound Design specialisation must submit (a) an audiovisual work in which they conceived or participated in creating the sound design, on DVD-video, AT LEAST 3 COPIES, and (b) a written analysis of the submitted audiovisual work explaining the sound-design concept and the sources of the sounds, music and sound effects. Length of the work is NOT specified.
auditionSpec: PORTFOLIO + WRITTEN ANALYSIS, not an audition and not an ear test. No performance or ear-training requirement found. Full exam procedure varies year to year — UNVERIFIED whether a practical production task is included.
tuitionNonEU: UNVERIFIED. Croatian public universities set their own fees for third-country nationals; no ADU figure could be retrieved.
scholarshipName: Croatian bilateral/Government scholarships administered by AMPEU (Agency for Mobility and EU Programmes) and the Ministry of Science, Education and Youth — Tunisia eligibility and amounts UNVERIFIED.
verdict: GENUINE MASTER'S with a PORTFOLIO gate (no audition, no ear test) — the friendliest gate found so far. But Croatian-language, film-sound rather than records, and he has no portfolio yet.

institution: Sveučilište u Zagrebu, Muzička akademija (University of Zagreb Academy of Music)
program: n/a — no music production or recording programme
accreditationStatus: NO MUSIC PRODUCTION / SOUND RECORDING PROGRAMME. The University of Zagreb's own graduate-programme index for the arts field lists no Muzička akademija programme in sound, music production or recording; the only recording-related graduate programme in the arts field at Zagreb is 'Snimanje' (cinematography) at ADU. Separately, the Academy's Composition degree is an INTEGRATED five-year programme with NO master's entry point.
verdict: EXCLUDE — no such degree. (Private alternatives in Zagreb — MPA Akademija, United Academy BA Music and Audio Production — are BA/non-degree and out of scope.)

institution: Masarykova univerzita, Filozofická fakulta, Ústav hudební vědy (Masaryk University, Faculty of Arts, Institute of Musicology)
program: Zvukový design a multimediální technologie (Sound Design and Multimedia Technologies)
qualification: Magistr (Mgr.) — navazující magisterské studium (follow-up master's), second cycle
accreditationStatus: REAL, ACCREDITED SECOND CYCLE. Professionally oriented follow-up master's; created under the 'Masaryk University 4.0' labour-market-relevance project. Available jednooborově (single-subject) or as a major/minor combination.
language: Czech (čeština). Offered in prezenční (full-time) or kombinovaná (blended, contact teaching several times a semester on Thursdays and Fridays) form. NO English-taught version.
whatYouStudy: VERBATIM: 'Cílem studia je příprava absolventů studijního programu na plnění požadavků praktického provozu, ve kterém je kreativně nakládáno se zvukem.' Four thematic blocks: 'Zvuková tvorba – technické předpoklady (matematika, fyzika, akustika, studiová technika); Zvuková tvorba – produkční předpoklady (zvukový design); Produkce zvuku; programování zvuku (práce ve studiu a se studiovou technikou, audio software); Teorie, dějiny a současnost zvukové tvorby (zvuková studia).' CRUCIALLY, the practicum block is explicit record-making: 'práce v nahrávacím studiu (stavba nahrávací techniky ve studiu / nahrávání / postprodukce / MASTERING / administrativa), ozvučení živé hudební produkce, autonomní zvuková produkce v digitálních prostředích DAWs, Pure Data ad.' Practice runs across all four semesters plus a compulsory six-week external placement (partners include Filharmonie Brno, Národní divadlo Brno, RoSound, Národní filmový archiv, Rozhlas a televízia Slovenska, Centrum současného umění DOX). The programme is broader than pop-record production — it also serves theatre, galleries, film, radio/TV, games and installations — but recording, post-production and mastering are named core competences.
entryRequirements: VERBATIM: 'Komu je program určen: Program je určen absolventům bakalářského studia – bez omezení.' (The programme is intended for graduates of bachelor's studies — WITHOUT RESTRICTION.) A foreign bachelor's degree requires 'a certificate of recognition of foreign higher education and qualifications' (nostrifikace) — this can take up to two months; Germany, Hungary, Poland and Slovenia are exempt by bilateral treaty, Tunisia is NOT, so budget the recognition step.
acceptsNonMusic: YES — EXPLICITLY. QUOTED: 'Program je určen absolventům bakalářského studia – bez omezení.' No music degree, no conservatoire training and no prior field of any kind is required. A BSc in Software Engineering is squarely eligible; the exam even rewards 'produkce a programování zvuku' knowledge, which plays to his background.
portfolioSpec: NOT A HARD PORTFOLIO. VERBATIM: 'Uchazeč/ka předloží detailní návrh vlastního kreativního projektu (max. 2 normostrany), který odráží jeho motivaci a profiluje směr jeho studia. … Ukázky vlastních tvůrčích prací s detailnějším autorským komentářem jsou vítány.' — a detailed proposal for the applicant's own creative project, MAXIMUM 2 standard pages, uploaded to the e-application under 'Dokumenty' by 1 JUNE, with the applicant's full name and application number on it. Samples of the applicant's own creative work with detailed authorial commentary are WELCOMED but NOT REQUIRED, and no number, length or file format is prescribed. This is the single most forgiving submission requirement found in the entire sweep for someone with no portfolio yet.
auditionSpec: NO AUDITION, NO EAR-TRAINING EXAM, NO PRACTICAL PRODUCTION TEST. VERBATIM: 'Přijímací zkouška má formu ústního pohovoru a je složena ze dvou částí: 1. Zkouška odborných a uměleckých předpokladů … Okruhy otázek vycházejí z následujících tematických okruhů: technické předpoklady zvukové tvorby, produkční předpoklady zvukové tvorby, produkce a programování zvuku, teorie, estetika a historie zvukové tvorby. 2. Kreativní projekt a motivace ke studiu.' It is an ORAL INTERVIEW: a knowledge examination on sound technique/production/theory (max 40 points) plus defence of the creative project and motivation (max 60 points). Scoring: 'V přijímacím řízení je možné dosáhnout maximálně 100 bodů. Pro přijetí je nutné dosáhnout minimálně 50 bodů.' Reading list published (Cox & Warner Audiokultúra; Kurfürst Základy hudební akustiky; Flašar Elektroakustická hudba; Schafer; Nyman; Bourriaud) — the exam is studiable. Waiver of the knowledge part is granted only to graduates of Teorie interaktivních médií, Sdružená uměnovědná studia, Hudební věda and Teorie a provozovací praxe staré hudby.
tuitionNonEU: FREE — 0 CZK. Czech-taught degree programmes at Czech PUBLIC universities carry no tuition for any nationality, including non-EU. This programme is taught only in Czech, so the free rate is the applicable rate. (Masaryk charges a foreign-language admission-procedure fee only for programmes taught in a foreign language — not this one.)
otherFees: Admission-procedure fee: 600–900 CZK depending on faculty (≈ €24–36), non-refundable. Recognition (nostrification) of the foreign bachelor's degree is a separate paid administrative process taking up to two months. Living costs in Brno ≈ CZK 15,000–20,000/month (≈ €600–800) — UNVERIFIED.
totalCostEstimate: ≈ €30 in fees plus recognition costs plus ≈ €14,000–19,000 living over two years. TUITION IS ZERO. Cheapest genuinely suitable programme found in the entire region.
scholarshipName: Czech Government Scholarships (Vládní stipendia ČR) administered by the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports via Czech embassies — for developing-country nationals; SPECIFIC TUNISIA ELIGIBILITY AND AMOUNTS UNVERIFIED. Note that with zero tuition the practical need is a living-cost stipend rather than a fee waiver.
scholarships: UNVERIFIED at programme level. MUNI operates faculty merit and social scholarships — details not retrieved.
languageRequirement: CZECH. MUNI requires 'proof of proficiency in the language of instruction'; the exact level and accepted certificates for follow-up master's applicants ARE NOT PUBLISHED on the application guide — UNVERIFIED. The entrance exam itself is an oral interview conducted in Czech, so functional Czech is required in practice. MUNI offers preparatory language courses for applicants who need them. THIS IS THE ONE REAL BARRIER: he has Arabic, French and English, and would need roughly a year of Czech before the September 2027 interview.
deadline: PRIOR CYCLE: applications 1 January – 30 April (2026 round: 1. 1. – 30. 4. 2026). The Faculty of Arts also runs a second window 1 August – 30 November. The creative project must be uploaded to the e-application by 1 JUNE. Expect 1 Jan – 30 April 2027 for a September 2027 start.
verdict: BEST OVERALL FIT IN THE SWEEP ON PAPER. Free tuition for a non-EU national, explicitly open to bachelor's graduates of ANY field, no audition and no ear test, and the submission is a 2-page project proposal rather than finished tracks. Recording, post-production and mastering are taught. The only blocker is Czech.

institution: Univerzita Konštantína Filozofa v Nitre (UKF), Pedagogická fakulta
program: Hudba a zvukový dizajn (Music and Sound Design)
qualification: Mgr. — magisterský (second cycle); also offered at bachelor's level
accreditationStatus: REAL SECOND CYCLE, registered in the Slovak higher-education register (portalvs.sk). New-ish programme at the Faculty of Education.
whatYouStudy: Prepares graduates as sound engineer (zvukový majster), sound and music dramaturg, and music editor/publicist in cultural institutions and media — theatres, concert halls, radio and television — plus artistic agencies, music publishers, foundations, and curatorship of music collections in museums and archives. Broadcast/institutional sound rather than record production.

NOT QUOTED VERBATIM FROM THE PAGE — retrieved via search summary; treat as UNVERIFIED wording, but the field restriction is unambiguous.

auditionSpec: EAR-TRAINING / MUSICIANSHIP EXAM — candidate cannot pass. Applicants must demonstrate rhythmic and aural-intonational abilities plus music theory at three-year bachelor level.
tuitionNonEU: UNVERIFIED. Slovak-language study at a Slovak public university is normally free for full-time students of any nationality, subject to the standard-length rule — VERIFY.
scholarshipName: Národný štipendijný program SR / Slovak Government Scholarship
verdict: EXCLUDE — music-degree entry requirement plus an aural-intonation test.

institution: Academia Națională de Muzică „Gheorghe Dima" (ANMGD)
accreditationStatus: NO SOUND-ENGINEERING / MUSIC-PRODUCTION MASTER. Verbatim from the Academy's own Admitere page, MASTER level: 'Facultatea de Interpretare Muzicală — Programe de studii: Interpretare muzicală – instrumente, Interpretare muzicală – canto, Artele spectacolului muzical, Coreologie. Facultatea Teoretică — Programe de studii: Artă muzicală, Artă muzicală / Musical Art (în limba engleză), Compoziție, Muzicologie, Dirijat.' language: Romanian; NOTE one master's, 'Artă muzicală / Musical Art', is delivered IN ENGLISH — but it is a music-art degree, not production. The Academy also runs a 'Studies in English' section and an 'Informatică muzicală' (music informatics) postgraduate COURSE (curs postuniversitar), which is not a degree.

scholarshipName: Romanian MAE scholarships (Ministry of Foreign Affairs, via Romanian diplomatic missions) — amounts and Tunisia eligibility UNVERIFIED

institution: Universitatea Hyperion din București, Facultatea de Arte „Geo Saizescu"
accreditationStatus: NO SOUND PROGRAMME AT ANY LEVEL. The Faculty of Arts has one department (Acting–Cinematography) and two LICENȚĂ specialisations: Theatre Performance Arts (Acting) and Film Direction. Film sound in Romania is at UNATC ('Arta sunetului de film'), which is already covered.

program: Snimanje i dizajn zvuka (Sound Recording and Design), Odsjek dramskih umjetnosti / FTV smjer
qualification: NOT A MASTER'S — first cycle only. 'diplomirani dizajner zvuka' after four years / 240 ECTS.

portfolioSpec: For the BA: a self-produced audio work of UP TO 2 MINUTES on portable memory in .wav FORMAT, with a written explanation of the equipment and methodology used. (Recorded here as a useful reference point for regional norms, but this is a bachelor's requirement.)
auditionSpec: For the BA: a two-day exam covering general culture, MUSICALITY AND RHYTHM ASSESSMENT (an ear/aptitude gate), audio-technology knowledge, sound-source identification, and an interview analysing the submitted work. Also requires a medical certificate INCLUDING AN AUDIOGRAM from an official health institution.

accreditationStatus: NO SOUND PROGRAMME AT MASTER'S LEVEL. TREAT AS UNVERIFIED.

institution: Univerzitet Crne Gore — Muzička akademija Cetinje and Fakultet dramskih umjetnosti Cetinje
accreditationStatus: NO SOUND-RECORDING OR MUSIC-PRODUCTION MASTER. The Music Academy is a performance/pedagogy conservatoire.

institution: V. Sarajishvili Tbilisi State Conservatoire
accreditationStatus: NO SOUND-ENGINEERING OR PRODUCTION MASTER. The Conservatoire runs exactly THREE MA programmes: performing art (all specialties), composition, and musicology. auditionSpec: PERFORMANCE AUDITION for the performing-art MA

institution: Komitas State Conservatory of Yerevan; Ilia State University; Academia de Muzică, Teatru și Arte Plastice (AMTAP) Chișinău
accreditationStatus: NO MUSIC-PRODUCTION OR SOUND-ENGINEERING MASTER IDENTIFIED at any of the three. Komitas Yerevan awards bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees in musical disciplines and OWNS a sound-recording studio, but no sound/production master's programme could be located. Ilia State University offers master's programmes including Music, but no sound/production specialisation could be located. ALL THREE ARE UNVERIFIED NEGATIVES — no official programme catalogue could be read, so absence is inferred, not proven.

institution: İstanbul Bilgi Üniversitesi; Mimar Sinan GSÜ; Anadolu Üniversitesi; Hacettepe Üniversitesi; İstanbul Üniversitesi Devlet Konservatuvarı; Sabancı; Koç; Kadir Has
program: n/a — no music-production master found at any of the eight
accreditationStatus: NO YÜKSEK LİSANS IN MUSIC PRODUCTION / SOUND TECHNOLOGY FOUND AT ANY OF THE EIGHT ASSIGNED TURKISH INSTITUTIONS. Bilgi's music offer that combines composition and sound technologies (and names 'tonmaister, music producer, sound designer' among graduate destinations) is a LİSANS (bachelor's) programme, not a master's. Hacettepe's music master's are Musicology, Historical Musicology and Müzik Teorileri (Music Theories) — no sound track. Mimar Sinan GSÜ publishes no ses/müzik teknolojisi master's. Anadolu produced no such programme. İstanbul Üniversitesi Devlet Konservatuvarı offers master's level study but its 'Ses' programme is Ses Eğitimi (VOICE training) and its music-technology content sits at lisans level. Sabancı, Koç and Kadir Has have no music-production master's. THE ONLY TURKISH MASTER'S IN THIS FIELD REMAIN THE ONES ALREADY COVERED: İTÜ MİAM (Müzik Tezli Yüksek Lisans, whose specialisms include 'Ses Mühendisliği ve Tasarımı' — Sound Engineering and Design) and Bahçeşehir (Ses Teknolojisi Tezli Yüksek Lisans, 2 years).
scholarshipName: Türkiye Bursları (Türkiye Scholarships) — FULLY FUNDED: covers tuition, monthly stipend, accommodation, health insurance, university placement, plus a Turkish-language year. Age limit under 30 for master's. 2026 round: applications 10 JANUARY – 20 FEBRUARY 2026; evaluation March–April; interviews April–June; results early August. NO EVIDENCE FOUND THAT ANY UNIVERSITY HAS BEEN ADDED to the Arts/Music window beyond İTÜ, Ankara Müzik ve Güzel Sanatlar Üniversitesi and Ankara Hacı Bayram Veli — the official Türkiye Bursları site does not publish a discipline-specific university list that could be retrieved, so this remains UNVERIFIED rather than disproven. Expect a 10 Jan – 20 Feb 2027 window for a September 2027 start.
scholarships: Türkiye Bursları is the single most valuable funding route in this whole territory for a Tunisian under 30 — but only İTÜ MİAM among the covered institutions is both in-field and (as far as can be confirmed) inside the scheme.
languageRequirement: Turkish for most; English at İTÜ MİAM
verdict: NO NEW TURKISH PROGRAMME. The territory adds nothing beyond the already-covered İTÜ MİAM and Bahçeşehir.

institution: Akademia Muzyczna im. Grażyny i Kiejstuta Bacewiczów w Łodzi (Grażyna and Kiejstut Bacewicz Academy of Music in Łódź), Instytut Mediów i Produkcji Muzycznej, Wydział Twórczości, Interpretacji, Edukacji i Produkcji Muzycznej
program: Muzyka w mediach i produkcja muzyczna (Music in Media and Music Production), specjalność REALIZACJA DŹWIĘKU (Sound Production)
qualification: Magister sztuki (Master of Arts) — studia stacjonarne drugiego stopnia (full-time second cycle)
accreditationStatus: REAL, FULL-TIME SECOND CYCLE. The Academy runs a dedicated second-cycle exam page for 'REALIZACJA DŹWIĘKU – studia stacjonarne drugiego stopnia'. The degree field is Muzyka w mediach i produkcja muzyczna: 3 years at first cycle, 2 years at second cycle. A sister specialisation, Muzyka w mediach (music journalism/media), also exists at second cycle — do not confuse the two.
language: Polish. The Academy has an 'English Division'-style English offer only for vocal-acting and instrumental studies (see fee decision); this programme is Polish-taught.
durationEcts: 2 years / 4 semesters (120 ECTS — ECTS figure UNVERIFIED)
whatYouStudy: VERBATIM (translated from the official programme page): the studies are addressed to first-cycle graduates who wish to obtain a master's degree in music in media and music production, specialisation sound production, and who want to DEEPEN KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS IN SOUND PRODUCTION IN THE FIELD OF CLASSICAL, POPULAR AND ELECTROACOUSTIC MUSIC, as well as gain knowledge of sound operation in audiovisual forms and the ability to realise live programmes. The Academy owns its own Studio Nagrań (recording studio).
entryRequirements: VERBATIM: 'absolwentów studiów pierwszego stopnia' — first-cycle graduates. Documents for second cycle: signed application form; original/certified copy of secondary-school certificate; original/certified copy of the bachelor's diploma; copy of the diploma supplement; digital photo (min. 246x304 px); proof of payment of the entrance-exam fee; and a programme listing the works for the entrance exam. International candidates must additionally supply translated diplomas and passport/visa documentation.
acceptsNonMusic: NOT STATED EITHER WAY. The page says only 'absolwentów studiów pierwszego stopnia' with no field named — so on its face any bachelor's qualifies, and NO music diploma is demanded. HOWEVER the oral exam presumes subject knowledge (electroacoustics, studio technique, microphone technique) at first-cycle level, so a non-specialist would be examined on ground he has not covered. COULD NOT QUOTE A PAGE EXPLICITLY WELCOMING NON-MUSIC BACKGROUNDS.
portfolioSpec: EXACT, VERBATIM: 'Przedstawienie trzech autorskich nagrań o różnej instrumentacji (wraz z partyturami, jeśli są dostępne)' — presentation of THREE original (self-authored) recordings with DIFFERENT INSTRUMENTATION, together with scores if available. One of the three may be replaced by a film sound design, an audio drama (słuchowisko) or a sound scene. No track length or file format is prescribed.
auditionSpec: NOT AN AUDITION — but a PARTIAL AURAL GATE plus a MEDICAL HEARING TEST. Three components: (1) the three-recording portfolio above; (2) an ORAL EXAM on 'wybrane zagadnienia z przedmiotów kierunkowych (elektroakustyka, technika studyjna, znajomość metod mikrofonowania, SOLFEŻ BARWY, język angielski specjalistyczny)' — selected topics from the core subjects: electroacoustics, studio technique, knowledge of microphone methods, TIMBRE SOLFÈGE, and specialist English; (3) a qualification interview on motivation, specialist interests, expectations and career plans. NOTE: 'solfeż barwy' is a TIMBRE ear test (identifying and describing tone colour and processing), not melodic/harmonic ear training and not an instrument audition — it is trainable, but it is a genuine aural component and must not be described as absent. SEPARATELY: 'Od kandydata wymagany jest pozytywny wynik badania audiometrycznego' — a POSITIVE AUDIOMETRIC (hearing) TEST RESULT IS REQUIRED. This is a medical hearing screen, not a musicianship test, but it is a hard pass/fail.
tuitionNonEU: NOT PUBLISHED FOR THIS PROGRAMME — a genuinely important gap. The Rector's decision of 30 April 2026 on foreigners' fees for 2026/2027 sets rates ONLY for studies conducted IN ENGLISH: first cycle — vocal-acting 55,200 PLN / €13,020; instrumental (piano, organ, harpsichord) 40,000 PLN / €9,440; instrumental (strings, wind, percussion) 42,000 PLN / €9,905. Second cycle — vocal-acting 49,300 PLN / €11,627; instrumental 56,300 PLN / €13,278; rytmika 45,000 PLN / €10,613. NO RATE IS LISTED FOR POLISH-TAUGHT STUDY, and Muzyka w mediach i produkcja muzyczna is Polish-taught. This means either (a) foreigners admitted to the Polish-taught programme pay nothing beyond the entry fee, or (b) a rate is set case by case. DIRECT ENQUIRY REQUIRED — this single question could turn Łódź into a near-free option or a €10,000+ one. Secondary sources state foreigners at AM Łódź pay 'at least €4,000/year depending on specialisation' plus a €200 first-year application fee; THIS DOES NOT MATCH the official 2026/27 decision and should not be relied on.
otherFees: Wpisowe (matriculation fee) for all forms of study in the first year: 180 PLN / 43 EUR, per the Rector's decision. Entrance-exam fee payable via the individual account in the online recruitment system — AMOUNT NOT PUBLISHED. Fees may be paid in two equal semester instalments, due 15 October and 1 March.
totalCostEstimate: UNVERIFIED — hinges entirely on whether a Polish-taught non-EU rate exists. Best case ≈ €43 in fees plus living; worst case ≈ €10,000+/year.
scholarshipName: NAWA Banach Scholarship Programme (Tunisia eligibility UNVERIFIED); the NAWA Łukasiewicz programme is CLOSED (last call 2020). The Academy runs a SPINAKER programme and a Biuro Współpracy Międzynarodowej — no student scholarship scheme for degree-seeking non-EU applicants was identified.

englishTest: None for admission, but SPECIALIST ENGLISH IS AN EXAMINED TOPIC in the oral entrance exam — his working English is an asset here rather than a barrier.
deadline: PRIOR CYCLE (2026/2027): online registration and submission of documents for full-time first- and second-cycle studies by 29 MAY 2026. Entrance exams 22 JUNE – 5 JULY 2026. A supplementary recruitment round ('Dodatkowa rekrutacja na studia na rok akademicki 2026/2027') also ran. Expect an equivalent late-May 2027 deadline with late-June/early-July 2027 exams for a September 2027 start.
verdict: SECOND-STRONGEST CONTENT MATCH IN POLAND and the only regional master's whose title literally says 'music production'. Gate is a 3-recording portfolio plus a knowledge oral — no instrument audition. Watch the timbre-solfège component and the compulsory audiometric test. Polish-language. Tuition position must be clarified by direct enquiry.

verdict: THE FUNDING PICTURE IS POOR. The one fully funded scheme (Türkiye Bursları) points only at İTÜ MİAM, which is already covered. Everywhere else the realistic play is free Czech-taught tuition at Masaryk Brno, not a scholarship.
